newsitem.title: USA: Champion Enterprises revamps Redman staff.
newsitem.headline: Champion Enterprises revamps Redman staff.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc. said Wednesday it will close the Dallas office of its recently acquired Redman Industries unit and move operations currently handled by about 80 members of Redman's staff to other offices.

Champion Enterprises, which makes manufactured housing, also announced the resignation of Robert Linton as president and chief executive of Redman, which before merging with Champion Enterprises last month was the nation's third-largest maker of pre-fab housing.

The Dallas job functions will be transferred to other plants, regional offices or to Champion's corporate offices in Auburn Hills over the next six months, the company said. A company spokesman said the majority of the affected workers will be offered the opportunity to relocate.
Champion Enterprises finished trading down 1/2 to 22-3/4.
